G4477.def:
A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.2.1;
mother of: Boaz (H1162)(?)
§ Rahab, "spacious, broad"
**Rachab,** (Proper name), _indeclinable_, [[Mat.1.5|Mt. 1:5]]*

G4441.def:
**πυνθώ᾽ομαι **
[in LXX for דָּרַשׁ ;]
1. **to inquire**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Jhn.4.42|Jhn.4:42]], [[Act.23.20|Act.23:20]]; before quæst. indir., [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], [[Luk.15.25; 18.36|Luk.15:25 18:36]], [[Act.10.18; 21.33|Act.10:18 21:33]]; quæst. dir., [[Act.4.7; 10.20; 23.10|Act.4:7 10:20 23:10]]; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], [[Jhn.4.52|Jhn.4:52]].
2. **to learn by inquiry**: before ὅτι, [[Act.23.34|Act.23:34]]†
(AS)

G4491.def:
**ῥίζα**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַשׁ ;]
**a root**: [[Mat.3.10|Mat.3:10]], [[Luk.3.9|Luk.3:9]]; ἐκ ῥιζῶν, [[Mrk.11.20|Mrk.11:20]] ῥ. ἔχειν, [[Mat.13.6|Mat.13:6]], [[Mrk.4.6|Mrk.4:6]]; id. before ἐν ἑαυτῷ, figuratively, [[Mat.13.21|Mat.13:21]], [[Mrk.4.17|Mrk.4:17]], [[Luk.8.13|Luk.8:13]]. Metaphorical (as in various senses in cl.), of cause, origin, source, etc.;
(a) of things, ῥ. πάντων τ. κακῶν (Eur.), [[1Ti.6.10|1Ti.6:10]]
(b) **of persons**: of ancestors, [[Rom.11.16-18;|Rom.11:16-18]] ῥ. πικρίας, [[Heb.12.15|Heb.12:15]] Of that which springs from a root, a shoot; metaphorically, of offspring, [[Rom.15.12|Rom.15:12]] (LXX) [[Rev.5.5; 22.16|Rev.5:5 22:16]].†
(AS)

G4442.def:
**πῦρ ** genitive, πυρός, τό,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for אֵשׁ ;]
**fire**: [[Mrk.9.22|Mrk.9:22]], [[Luk.3.9|Luk.3:9]], [[Jhn.15.6|Jhn.15:6]], [[Act.2.10|Act.2:10]], [[1Co.3.13|1Co.3:13]], [[Jas.3.5|Jas.3:5]], [[Rev.8.5|Rev.8:5]], al; π. καὶ θεῖον, [[Luk.17.29|Luk.17:29]] κατακαίειν (ἐν) π., [[Mat.13.40|Mat.13:40]], [[Rev.17.16; 18.8|Rev.17:16 18:8]]; καίεσθαι πυρί, [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]], [[Rev.8.8; 21.8|Rev.8:8 21:8]]; φλὸξ πυρός, [[Act.7.30|Act.7:30]], [[2Th.1.8|2Th.1:8]], [[Heb.1.7|Heb.1:7]], [[Rev.1.14; 2.18; 19.12|Rev.1:14 2:18 19:12]]; λαμπάδες πυρός, [[Rev.4.5|Rev.4:5]] στῦλοι πυρός, [[Rev.10.1|Rev.10:1]] ἄνθρακες πυρός, [[Rom.12.20|Rom.12:20]] (LXX); γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, [[Act.2.3|Act.2:3]] δοκιμάζειν (πυροῦσθαι) διὰ πυρός, [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]], [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]]; ὡς διὰ. π. (Lft., _Notes_, 193), [[1Co.3.15|1Co.3:15]] Of the fire of hell (cf. Dalman, _Words_,161): [[Mrk.9.48|Mrk.9:48]] (LXX); τὸ π. τὸ αἰώνιον, [[Mat.18.8; 25.41|Mat.18:8 25:41]] (cf. [[4Ma.12.12|4Ma.12:12]]); ἄσβεστον, [[Mrk.9.43|Mrk.9:43]] πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχειν, [[Jude.7|Ju 7]]; γέεννα τοῦ π., [[Mat.5.22; 18.9|Mat.5:22 18:9]]; κάμινος τοῦ π., [[Mat.13.42, 50|Mat.13:42, 50]]; ἡ λίμνη τοῦ π., [[Rev.19.20; 20.10, 14-15|Rev.19:20 20:10, 14-15]]; πυρὶ τηρεῖσθαι, [[2Pe.3.7|2Pe.3:7]] βασανισθῆναι ἐν π., [[Rev.14.10|Rev.14:10]] Metaphorical: βαπτίζειν πυρί, [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]] of the tongue, [[Jas.3.5|Jas.3:5]] of strife and discord, [[Luk.12.49|Luk.12:49]] ἐκ π. ἁρπάζειν, [[Jude.23|Ju 23]]; πυρὶ αλίζεσθαι, [[Mrk.9.49|Mrk.9:49]] ζῆλος πυρός, [[Heb.10.27|Heb.10:27]] of God, π, καταναλίσκον, [[Heb.12.29|Heb.12:29]] (LXX)
(AS)

G4425.def:
**πτύον**, -ου, τό
[in Sm.: [[Isa.30.24|Isa.30:24]] * ;]
**a winnowing shovel or fan**: [[Mat.3.12|Mat.3:12]], [[Luk.3.17|Luk.3:17]].†
(AS)

G4487.def:
**ῥῆμα**, -τος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, also for פֶּה, and Aram. פִּתְגָּם, etc. ;]
1. prop., of that which is said or spoken,
(a) **a word**: [[Mat.27.14|Mat.27:14]], [[2Co.12.4|2Co.12:4]]; pl., τὰ ῥ., of speech, discourse, [[Luk.7.1|Luk.7:1]], [[Jhn.8.20|Jhn.8:20]], [[Act.2.14|Act.2:14]], [[Rom.10.18|Rom.10:18]], [[2Pe.3.2|2Pe.3:2]], al.;
(b) opposite to ὄνομα (a single word), a saying, statement, word of prophecy, **instruction or command **(in cl., phrase): [[Mat.26.75|Mat.26:75]], [[Mrk.9.32|Mrk.9:32]], [[Luk.1.38; 2.50|Luk.1:38 2:50]], [[Act.11.16|Act.11:16]], [[Rom.10.8|Rom.10:8]], [[Heb.11.3|Heb.11:3]]; ῥ. θεοῦ (κυρίου), [[Luk.3.2|Luk.3:2]], [[Act.11.16|Act.11:16]], [[Eph.6.17|Eph.6:17]], [[Heb.6.5; 11.3|Heb.6:5 11:3]], [[1Pe.1.25|1Pe.1:25]]" (LXX) ; τὰ ῥ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Jhn.3.34; 8.47|Jhn.3:34 8:47]]; ῥ. ἀργόν, [[Mat.12.36|Mat.12:36]]ῥ. ἄρρητα, [[2Co.12.4|2Co.12:4]]
2. Like _Heb._ דָּבָר (but perh. also a Gk. colloquialism, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 124; Thackeray, _Gr._, 41), of that which is the subject of speech, a thing, matter ([[Gen.15.1|Gen.15:1]], [[Deu.17.8|Deu.17:8]], al.): [[Luk.1.37; 2.15|Luk.1:37 2:15]], [[Act.10.37|Act.10:37]]; pl., [[Luk.1.65; 2.19, 51|Luk.1:65 2:19, 51]], [[Act.5.32; 13.42|Act.5:32 13:42]]
(AS)

G4419.def:
**πτερύγιον**, -ου, -τό
(dimin. of πτέρυξ), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;]
1. a little wing.
2. **Anything like a wing, as a turret, battlement**: τ. ἱεροῦ, [[Mat.4.5|Mat.4:5]], [[Luk.4.9|Luk.4:9]].†
(AS)

G4469.def:
**ῥακά** (T, ῥαχά),
usually taken to represent the Aram. רֵיקָא, a shortened form of H7386, " empty," as vocalized in the Galilæan dialect; an expression of contempt, **raca**: [[Mat.5.22|Mat.5:22]] (cf. _DB_, iv, 191 f.; and for other explanations, see Zorell, see word).†
(AS)

G4413.def:
B. _Superl._, **πρῶτος**, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
**first**,
1. **of Time or Place**;
(a) absol., as _subst._, ὁ π.., [[Luk.14.18|Luk.14:18]], [[Jhn.19.32|Jhn.19:32]], [[1Co.14.30|1Co.14:30]]; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, [[Rev.1.17; 2.8; 22.13|Rev.1:17 2:8 22:13]]; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, [[Heb.10.9|Heb.10:9]] τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, [[Mat.12.45|Mat.12:45]], [[Luk.11.26|Luk.11:26]], [[2Pe.2.20|2Pe.2:20]]; anarth., [[Mat.10.2|Mat.10:2]] pl., [[Mat.19.30|Mat.19:30]], [[Mrk.10.31|Mrk.10:31]], [[Luk.13.30|Luk.13:30]]; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, **first of all**), [[1Co.15.3|1Co.15:3]]
(b) as _adj._: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, [[Act.12.10|Act.12:10]] equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[[[7].20.4|7] 20:4]], 8 [[Act.27.43|Act.27:43]], [[Rom.10.19|Rom.10:19]], [[1Ti.1.16|1Ti.1:16]], [[1Jn.4.19|1Jn.4:19]]; = πρότερος (see infr.; cf. M, _Pr._, 79; Bl, §11, 5; Thackeray, _Gr._, 183f.): with genitive, π. μου ἦν (_my chief_: Abbott, _Jg._, 509ff.; but cf. M, _Pr._, 245), [[Jhn.1.15, 30|Jhn.1:15, 30]]; with art., [[Mrk.14.12|Mrk.14:12]], [[Act.1.1|Act.1:1]], al.; before ὁ δεύτερος, etc., [[Mat.22.25|Mat.22:25]], [[Mrk.12.20|Mrk.12:20]], al.
2. Of Rank or Dignity, **chief, principal**: [[Mat.20.27; 22.38|Mat.20:27 22:38]], [[Mrk.9.35|Mrk.9:35]], [[Eph.6.2|Eph.6:2]], al.; with genitive, [[Mrk.12.28, 29|Mrk.12:28, 29]] al.; πόλις (Field, _Notes_, 124), [[Act.16.12|Act.16:12]] with art., [[Luk.15.22; 19.47|Luk.15:22 19:47]], [[Act.13.50|Act.13:50]], al.
3. Neut., πρῶτον, as _adv._, **first, at the first**;
(a) **of Time**: [[Mat.8.21|Mat.8:21]], [[Mrk.4.28|Mrk.4:28]], al.; τὸ π., [[Jhn.10.40|Jhn.10:40]], al.;
(b) **of Order**: [[Rom.3.2|Rom.3:2]], [[1Co.11.18|1Co.11:18]], al.
(AS)

G4474.def:
**ῥαπίζω**
(ῥαπίς, a rod), [in LXX: [[Jdg.16.25|Jdg.16:25]], [[Heb.11.4|Heb.11:4]], I [[Est.4.11|Est.4:11]] * ;]
1. prop., to strike with a rod.
2. In late writers, to strike (the face) with the palm of the hand: [[Mat.26.67|Mat.26:67]] with accusative of person(s), before εἰς τ. σιαγόνα, [[Mat.5.39|Mat.5:39]] (cf. Field, _Notes_, 40, 105).†
(AS)

G4459.def:
**πῶς**, _interrog. adv._, correl. of ὅπως,
1. prop., in direct questions, **how?**: with indic., [[Mat.12.29|Mat.12:29]], [[Mrk.3.23|Mrk.3:23]], [[Luk.11.18|Luk.11:18]], [[Jhn.3.4|Jhn.3:4]], al.; καὶ π., [[Mrk.4.13|Mrk.4:13]], [[Luk.20.44|Luk.20:44]]; π. οὖν, [[Mat.12.26|Mat.12:26]] π. οὐ, [[Mat.16.11|Mat.16:11]], [[Luk.12.56|Luk.12:56]]; in deliberative questions (cf. Bl., §64, 6), with subjc., [[Mat.23.33; 26.54|Mat.23:33 26:54]]; π. οὖν, [[Rom.10.14|Rom.10:14]] π. δέ, [[Rom.10.14, 15|Rom.10:14, 15]]; before ἄν, with optative, [[Act.8.31|Act.8:31]]
2. As sometimes in cl. but more frequently and increasingly so in late writers (see WM, §57, 2; Bl., §70, 2; Thumb, _MGr._, 192; Jannaris, _Gr._, _App._, vi, 13f.), = ὅπως, ὥς;
(a) **in indirect discourse**: with indic., [[Mat.6.28|Mat.6:28]], [[Mrk.12.41|Mrk.12:41]], [[Luk.8.36|Luk.8:36]], [[Jhn.9.15|Jhn.9:15]], [[Act.9.27|Act.9:27]], al.; with subjc., [[Mrk.11.18|Mrk.11:18]], [[Luk.12.11|Luk.12:11]];
(b) **in exclamations**: [[Mat.21.20|Mat.21:20]], [[Mrk.10.23, 24|Mrk.10:23, 24]] [[Luk.12.50; 18.24|Luk.12:50 18:24]], [[Jhn.11.36|Jhn.11:36]].
(AS)

G4483.def:
**λέγω**,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, [[Gen.22.16|Gen.22:16]], al. ;]
1. in Hom., **to pick out, gather, reckon, recount**.
2. In Hdt. and Att., **to say, speak, affirm, declare**: absol., [[Act.13.15; 24.10|Act.13:15, 24:10]]; before orat. dir., [[Mat.9.34|Mat.9:34]], [[Mrk.3.11|Mrk.3:11]], [[Jhn.1.29|Jhn.1:29]], al.; before ὅτι recit., [[Mrk.3.21|Mrk.3:21]], [[Luk.1.24|Luk.1:24]], [[Jhn.6.14|Jhn.6:14]], al.; accusative and inf., [[Luk.11.18|Luk.11:18]], [[Jhn.12.29|Jhn.12:29]], al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, [[Mat.11.17|Mat.11:17]], al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, _Words_, 24 ff.), [[Mat.25.9|Mat.25:9]], [[Mrk.3.33; 7.28|Mrk.3:33, 7:28]], [[Luk.24.6|Luk.24:6]], 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], [[Luk.3.8|Luk.3:8]], al.; of writing, [[2Co.8.8|2Co.8:8]], [[Php.4.11|Php.4:11]], al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, [[Rom.4.3|Rom.4:3]], [[Jas.2.23|Jas.2:23]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.8.8; 9.33|Luk.8:8, 9:33]], [[Jhn.5.34|Jhn.5:34]], al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, _Mk._, 359, 369f.), [[Mat.27.11|Mat.27:11]], [[Mrk.15.2|Mrk.15:2]], [[Luk.23.3|Luk.23:3]], [[Jhn.18.37|Jhn.18:37]]; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., [[Mat.8.20|Mat.8:20]], [[Mrk.2.17|Mrk.2:17]], al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]], [[Jhn.11.56|Jhn.11:56]], [[Heb.9.5|Heb.9:5]], al.; **to mean** (cl.), [[Mrk.14.71|Mrk.14:71]], [[Jhn.6.71|Jhn.6:71]], [[1Co.10.29|1Co.10:29]], al.; **to call, name**, [[Mrk.10.18|Mrk.10:18]] pass., [[Mat.9.9|Mat.9:9]], [[Mrk.15.7|Mrk.15:7]], al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
_SYN._: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., _Syn._, Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G4486.def:
**ῥήγνυμι** and ([[Mrk.9.18|Mrk.9:18]]) ῥήσσω,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע, also for קָרַע, etc. ;]
1. **to rend, break asunder**: [[Mat.7.6|Mat.7:6]], [[Mrk.2.22|Mrk.2:22]], [[Luk.5.37|Luk.5:37]]; pass., [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]]
2. Of the voice, with accusative, φωνήν, etc. (Hdt., al.), **to break forth into speech**: absol., [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]] (LXX).
3. = ῥήσσω (Dem., al.), **to throw or dash down**: [[Mrk.9.18|Mrk.9:18]], [[Luk.9.42|Luk.9:42]]
(cf. δια-, περι-, προσ-ρήγνυμι).†
_SYN._: θραύω, κατάγνυμι (AS)

G4439.def:
**πύλη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שַׁעַר sometimes for דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח ;]
**a gate**: [[Luk.7.12|Luk.7:12]], [[Act.9.24; 12.10; 16.13|Act.9:24 12:10 16:13]], [[Heb.13.12|Heb.13:12]]; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, [[Act.3.10|Act.3:10]] Metaphorical, [[Mat.7.13-14;|Mat.7:13-14]] πύλαι ᾅδου ([[Wis.16.13|Wis.16:13]], [[3Ma.5.51|3Ma.5:51]], and cf. κλαῖς ᾅδου [[Rev.1.18|Rev.1:18]]): [[Mat.16.18|Mat.16:18]].†
(AS)

G4431.def:
**πτῶσις**, -εως, ἡ
(πίπτω), [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶף, מַפֶּלֶת, and cogn. forms ;]
**a falling, fall **(Plat., Plut., al.): [[Mat.7.27|Mat.7:27]] metaphorically, [[Luk.2.34|Luk.2:34]]†
(AS)

G4446.def:
**πυρετός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(πῦρ) [in LXX: [[Deu.28.22|Deu.28:22]] (קַדַּחַת) * ;]
**a fever**: [[Mat.8.15|Mat.8:15]], [[Mrk.1.31|Mrk.1:31]], [[Luk.4.39|Luk.4:39]], [[Jhn.4.52|Jhn.4:52]], [[Act.28.8|Act.28:8]]; π. μέγας, **a high fever**: [[Luk.4.38|Luk.4:38]] (on the technical phrase here, see MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4470.def:
**ῥάκος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX: [[Isa.64.6|Isa.64:6]] (5) (בֶּגֶד), [[Jer.38.11|Jer.38:11]] (סְחָבָה), [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]] * ;]
1. a ragged garment (Hom.).
2. **a rag, remnant, piece of cloth**: [[Mat.9.16|Mat.9:16]], [[Mrk.2.21|Mrk.2:21]].†
(AS)

G4496.def:
**ῥίπτω** and ([[Act.22.23|Act.22:23]]) ῥιπτέω (strengthened form; see Veitch, see word ῥίπτω, fin.),
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;]
1. **to throw, cast, hurl**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.27.5|Mat.27:5]], [[Act.27.19, 29|Act.27:19, 29]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.15.30|Mat.15:30]], [[Luk.4.35|Luk.4:35]]; pass., [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]] ptcp., ἐριμμένοι, **cast down, prostrate **(Polyb., al.): [[Mat.9.36|Mat.9:36]] of garments, to throw off (for flight, Eur., Xen., al.; ὅπλα, [[1Ma.5.43|1Ma.5:43]] so EV in [[Act.22.23|Act.22:23]], but see infr.).
2. **= ῥιπτάζω, to shake, toss, throw about**: τ. ἱμάτια, [[Act.22.23|Act.22:23]] (EGT, Page, Rackham, in l; Field, _Notes_, 136; but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4464.def:
**ῥάβδος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מַטֶּה (e.g. [[Gen.47.31|Gen.47:31]], MT, מַטֶּה, bed), also for מַקֵּל, שֵׁבֶט, etc. ;]
**a staff, rod**: [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]], [[Rev.11.1|Rev.11:1]]; in particular,
(a) **a staff, such as is used on a journey**: [[Mat.10.10|Mat.10:10]], [[Mrk.6.8|Mrk.6:8]], [[Luk.9.3|Luk.9:3]], [[Heb.11.21|Heb.11:21]]" (LXX) ;
(b) **a ruler's staff, a sceptre**: [[Heb.1.8|Heb.1:8]] (LXX) [[Rev.2.27; 12.5; 19.15|Rev.2:27 12:5 19:15]];
(with) **a rod for chastisement **(cf. ῥαβδίζω): ἐν ῥ. (see: ἐν): [[1Co.4.21|1Co.4:21]]†
(AS)

G4430.def:
**πτῶμα -τος**, τό
(πίπτω), [in LXX: [[Jdg.14.8|Jdg.14:8]] (מַפֶּלֶת), [[Job.16.15|Job.16:15]] (14) (פֶּרֶץ), [[Isa.51.19|Isa.51:19]] (שֹׁד), [[Jdt.8.19|Jdth.8:19]], [[Wis.4.18|Wis.4:18]], al. ;]
1. a fall, metaphorically, a misfortune, calamity (Trag., Plat., Polyb., al.; LXX).
2. **That which has fallen**;
(a) **of buildings, a ruin **(Polyb.);
(b) of living creatures, in cl. (poët. only) usually with genitive, νεκρῶν, etc., but also absol., as in late writers and NT, **a fallen body, a carcase, corpse**: [[Mat.14.12; 24.28|Mat.14:12 24:28]], [[Mrk.15.45|Mrk.15:45]]; π. αὐτοῦ, [[Mrk.6.29|Mrk.6:29]] αὐτῶν, [[Rev.11.8-9|Rev.11:8-9]] (cf. Rutherford, _NPhr._, 472 f.).†
(AS)

G4449.def:
**πυρράζω**
(πυρρός), [in LXX, πυρρίζω: [[Lev.13.19, 42|Lev.13:19, 42]] ff. [[Lev.14.37|Lev.14:37]] (אֲדַמְדָּם) * ;]
**to be fiery red**: [[Mat.16.2-3|Mat.16:2-3]]†
(AS)

G4454.def:
**πῶλος**, -ου, ὁ
(in cl. also ) [in LXX chiefly for עַיִר ;]
a foal, colt, prop., of a horse, then the young of other animals; in NT of the colt of an ass: [[Mat.21.2|Mat.21:2]], 5" (LXX), [[Mat.21.7|Mat.21:7]], [[Mrk.11.2, 4-5; 11.7|Mrk.11:2, 4-5 11:7]], [[Luk.19.30, 33; 19.35|Luk.19:30, 33 19:35]], [[Jhn.12.15|Jhn.12:15]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4444.def:
**πύργος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מִגְדָּל ;]
**a tower**: [[Luk.13.4|Luk.13:4]] of a watch-tower in a vineyard ([[Isa.5.2|Isa.5:2]]): [[Mat.21.33|Mat.21:33]], [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]], and prob., [[Luk.14.28|Luk.14:28]]†
(AS)

G4411.def:
**πρωτο-κλυτία**, -ας, ἡ
**the chief place at table **(see Swete, _Mk._, l.with): [[Mat.23.6|Mat.23:6]], [[Mrk.12.39|Mrk.12:39]], [[Luk.14.7-8; 20.46|Luk.14:7-8 20:46]].†
(AS)

G4410.def:
**πρωτοκαθεδρία**, -ας, ἡ
(πρῶιος, καθέδρα),
**the chief seat**: [[Mat.23.6|Mat.23:6]], [[Mrk.12.39|Mrk.12:39]] (see Swete, in l), [[Luk.11.43; 20.46|Luk.11:43 20:46]].†
(AS)

G4461.def:
**ῥαββεί** (Rec. -βί, see WH, _App._, 155) (Heb. and Aram. רַב, my master; see Dalman, _Words_, 327, 331 ff.),
**a title of respectful address to Jewish teachers, Rabbi**: [[Mat.23.7-8;|Mat.23:7-8]] of John, [[Jhn.3.26|Jhn.3:26]] of Christ, [[Mat.26.25, 49|Mat.26:25, 49]], [[Mrk.9.5; 11.21; 14.45|Mrk.9:5 11:21 14:45]], [[Jhn.1.30, 50; 3.2; 4.31; 6.25; 9.2; 11.8|Jhn.1:30, 50 3:2 4:31 6:25 9:2 11:8]]; κύριε ῥ [[Mrk.10.51|Mrk.10:51]] (WH, mg., see: ῥαββουνεί).†
**ῥαββουνεί** (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, _Words_, 324, 340; _Gr._, 140; _DB_, iv, 190)
**Rabboni**: [[Mrk.10.51|Mrk.10:51]] (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), [[Jhn.20.16|Jhn.20:16]]†
(AS)

G4420.def:
**πτέρυξ**, -υγος, ἡ
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;]
**a wing**: of birds, [[Mat.23.37|Mat.23:37]], [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]], [[Rev.12.14|Rev.12:14]]; of creatures seen in a vision, [[Rev.4.8; 9.9|Rev.4:8 9:9]].†
(AS)

G4440.def:
**πυλών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
(πύλη), [in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, שַׁעַר ;]
1. the porch or vestibule of a house or palace: [[Mat.26.71|Mat.26:71]], [[Luk.16.20|Luk.16:20]], [[Act.10.17; 12.13-14|Act.10:17 12:13-14]]
2. **The gate-way or gate-tower of a walled town**: [[Act.14.13|Act.14:13]], [[Rev.21.12-13, 15; 21.21, 25; 22.14|Rev.21:12-13, 15 21:21, 25 22:14]].†
(AS)

G4405.def:
**πρώιος** (Rec. -ϊος), -α, -ον
(πρωί), [in LXX for בֹּקֶר בַּ לַּ ;]
**at early morn, early**; as subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὥρα, cf. ἡ ὥ. ἡ π., [[3Ma.5.24|3Ma.5:24]]), **early morning**: [[Mat.27.1|Mat.27:1]], [[Jhn.21.4|Jhn.21:4]].†
(AS)

G4457.def:
**πώρωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(πωρόω),
**a covering with a callus, a hardening**: metaphorically, [[Mrk.3.6|Mrk.3:6]], [[Rom.11.2|Rom.11:2]], [[Eph.4.18|Eph.4:18]].†
(AS)

G4403.def:
**πρύμνα**, -ης, ἡ
prop. fem. of adj. πρύμνο, -η, -ον, (sc. ναῦς), the hindmost part of a ship, **the stern**: [[Mrk.4.38|Mrk.4:38]], [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]]; opposite to πρῷρα, [[Act.27.41|Act.27:41]]†
(AS)

G4456.def:
**πωρόω**, -ῶ
(πῶρος, 1. a stone. 2. a callus) [in LXX: [[Job.17.7|Job.17:7]] B(כָּהָה), [[Pro.10.20|Pro.10:20]] A * ;]
to petrify, harden, form a callus. Metaphorical, π. τ. καρδίαν, [[Jhn.12.40|Jhn.12:40]] Pass., [[Rom.11.7|Rom.11:7]] τ. νοήματα, [[2Co.3.14|2Co.3:14]] ἡ καρδία, [[Mrk.6.52; 8.17|Mrk.6:52 8:17]] †
(AS)

G4435.def:
**πυγμή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Exo.21.18|Exo.21:18]], [[Isa.58.4|Isa.58:4]] (אֶגְרֹף) * ;]
**the fist**: πυγμῇ νίψασθαι τ. χῖρας (Τ, πυκνά; Vg., Goth., Copt., crebro), **to wash the hands with the fist **(diligently, R, txt.; up to the elbow, R, mg.; the exact meaning is doubtful; see Swete, in l): [[Mrk.7.3|Mrk.7:3]]†
(AS)

G4462.def:
**ῥαββουνεί** (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, _Words_, 324, 340; _Gr._, 140; _DB_, iv, 190)
**Rabboni**: [[Mrk.10.51|Mrk.10:51]] (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), [[Jhn.20.16|Jhn.20:16]]†
(AS)

G4475.def: **a stroke, a slap on the face **, (Lucian) (ML)

G4416.def:
**πρωτότοκος**, -ον
(πρῶτος, τίκτω) [in LXX chiefly for בְּכוֹר ;]
**first-born**: [[Luk.2.7|Luk.2:7]] pl., [[Heb.11.28|Heb.11:28]] Metaphorical, of the priority of Christ (originally perh. a Messianic title, cf. [[Psa.89.28|Psa.89:28]], [[Heb.1.6|Heb.1:6]]; see _ICC_ on [[Col.1.15|Col.1:15]]): [[Heb.1.6|Heb.1:6]]; π. πάσης κτίσεως, [[Col.1.15|Col.1:15]] ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, [[Rom.8.29|Rom.8:29]] π. (ἐκ) τ. νεκρῶν, [[Col.1.18|Col.1:18]], [[Rev.1.5|Rev.1:5]]; pl., of the elect, ἐκκλησία πρωτοτόκων, [[Heb.12.23|Heb.12:23]]†
(AS)

G4428.def:
**πτύσσω **
**to fold; of a scroll, to roll up**: βιβλίον, [[Luk.4.20|Luk.4:20]] (cf. ἀνα-πτύσσω).†
(AS)

G4437.def:
**πυκιός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: [[Ezk.31.3|Eze.31:3]] A (חֹרֶשׁ), [[3Ma.1.28|3Ma.1:28]] [[3Mac.4.10|3Mac 4:10]], [[4Ma.12.12|4Ma.12:12]] * ;]
1. close, compact, solid.
2. **frequent**: [[1Ti.5.23|1Ti.5:23]] Neut. pl., πυκνά, as adv., **much, often**: [[Mrk.7.3|Mrk.7:3]] Τ (see: πυγμή), [[Luk.5.33|Luk.5:33]] Comparat., πυκνότερον, **very often or so much the oftener **(seeBl., § 44, 3,): [[Act.24.26|Act.24:26]]†
(AS)

G4485.def:
**ῥῆγμα**, -τος, τό
(ῥήγνυμι), [in LXX: [[3Ki.11.30-31 12:24|3Ki.11:30-31 12:24]], [[2Ki.2.12|4Ki.2:12]] (קֶרַע), [[Amo.6.12|Amo.6:12]] (11) A (בְּקִיעַ) * ;]
1. cl. (and so in LXX), a fracture; then by meton., that which is torn.
2. **In NT, ruin**: [[Luk.6.49|Luk.6:49]]†
(AS)

G4422.def:
**πτοέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for חָתַת ni. ;]
to terrify. Pass., **to be terrified**: [[Luk.21.9; 24.37|Luk.21:9 24:37]] (WH, mg., θροηθέντες).†
(AS)

G4482.def:
**ῥέω **
[in LXX chiefly for זוּב ;]
**to flow**: [[Jhn.7.38|Jhn.7:38]] (cf. παραρρέω).†
(AS)

G4418.def:
**πτέρνα**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for עָקֵב ;]
**the heel**: figuratively, ἐπαίρειν τὴν π. ἐπί, [[Jhn.13.18|Jhn.13:18]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4400.def:
**προ-χειρίζω**
(πρόχειρος, at hand) [in LXX: [[Exo.4.13|Exo.4:13]] (שָׁלַח), [[Jos.3.12|Jos.3:12]] (לָקַח), Dan LXX 3:22, [[2Ma.3.7|2Ma.3:7]] [[2Mac.8.9|2Mac 8:9]] [[2Mac.14.12|2Mac 14:12]] A * ;]
1. **to put into the hand, deliver up**: pass., [[Act.3.20|Act.3:20]]
2. More frequently as depon., -ομαι, to take into one's hand; hence, metaphorically, **to propose, determine, choose**: with inf., [[Act.22.14|Act.22:14]] with accusative of person(s), [[Act.26.16|Act.26:16]]†
(AS)

G4481.def:
**Ῥεμφάν**, Ῥεφάς, see: Ῥομφά.
**Ῥομφά** (-άν, T; Ῥεφάν, LTr.; Ῥεμφάν, Rec.; see WH, _App._, 92),
[in LXX: [[Amo.5.26|Amo.5:26]] (Ῥαιμφάν or Ῥεφάν, _Heb._ כִּיּוּן)* ;]
Rompha, Rephan (RV), one of the names of Seb, **the Egyptian Saturn**: [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4401.def:
**προ-χειρο-τονέω**, -ῶ
(see χειροτονέω)
**to choose or appoint beforehand**: [[Act.10.41|Act.10:41]] (Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G4468.def:
**ῥᾳδιουργία**, -ας, ἡ
(see: ῥᾳδιούργημα),
1. ease in doing, facility (Xen.).
2. easiness, laziness (Xen.).
3. **recklessness, wickedness **(of lewdness, Xen.; fraud, Plut.; in π., of theft, MM, xxii): [[Act.13.10|Act.13:10]]†
(AS)

G4436.def:
**πύθων**, -ωνος, ὁ
1. in cl., Python, a serpent slain by Apollo, who is hence surnamed the Pythian.
2. In Plut. (ii, 414 E), a name given to ventriloquist soothsayers (ἐγγαστρίμυθοι; cf. [[Lev.19.31; 20.6, 27|Lev.19:31 20:6, 27]], [[1Sa.28.7|1Ki.28:7]]), and perhaps in this sense πνεῦμα πύθωνα, **a python-spirit**: [[Act.16.16|Act.16:16]]†
(AS)

G4467.def:
**ῥᾳδιούργημα**, -τος, τό
(ῥᾳδιουργέω, to act recklessly or wrongly)
1. a reckless act.
2. **crime, villany**: [[Act.18.14|Act.18:14]]†
(AS)

G4499.def: the isle of **Rhodes **, (Iliad by Homer), etc. (ML)

G4424.def:
**Πτολεμαΐς**, -ΐδος, ἡ
**Ptolemais, a maritime city of Phœnicea**: [[Act.21.7|Act.21:7]]†
(AS)

G4414.def:
**πρωτοστάτης**, -ου, ὁ
(πρῶτος, ἵστημι) [in LXX: [[Job.15.24|Job.15:24]] AB * ;]
prop., of soldiers, one who stands first, one in the front rank (Thuc., Xen.); hence, metaphorically, **a leader**: [[Act.24.5|Act.24:5]]†
(AS)

G4458.def:
**πως**,
_enclit. part._,
**at all**; see: εἴπως, μήπως.
**μήπως**
or μή πως (so WH),
negative particle,
1. as conjc., **lest haply**: in final sentences, [[1Co.9.27|1Co.9:27]], [[2Co.2.7; 9.4|2Co.2:7 9:4]]; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, [[1Co.8.9|1Co.8:9]], [[2Co.11.3; 12.20|2Co.11:3 12:20]], [[Gal.4.11|Gal.4:11]]; with an ellipse of ptcp. (sc. φοβούμενος; cf. B1., § 65, 3; Burton, § 225), [[1Th.3.5|1Th.3:5]] (but see infr.).
2. **As interrogative, whether haply**: [[Gal.2.2|Gal.2:2]], [[1Th.3.5|1Th.3:5]] (cf. M, _Th._, in l, but see supr.).†
μήπου
(WH, μή που),
**lest anywhere, lest haply**: [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]]†
(AS)

G4408.def:
**πρῷρα** (Rec. incorrectly πρώρα, see Bl., § 3, 3; LS, see word), -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, l 2), ἡ,
**the forward part of a ship, the prow**: [[Act.27.30|Act.27:30]] opposite to πρύμνα, ib. [[Act.27.41|Act.27:41]]†
(AS)

G4417.def:
**πταίω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַף ni. ;]
1. trans., to cause to stumble ([[1Sa.4.3|1Ki.4:3]], cf. Deiss., BS, 681).
2. Intrans., to stumble. Metaphorical, in moral sense, [[Rom.11.11|Rom.11:11]], [[Jas.2.10; 3.2|Jas.2:10 3:2]], [[2Pe.1.10|2Pe.1:10]].†
(AS)

G4448.def:
**πυρόω**, -ῶ
(πῦρ) [in LXX chiefly for צָרַף ;]
to set on fire, burn up. In NT always pass.,
1. **to be set on fire, to burn**: [[Eph.6.16|Eph.6:16]], [[2Pe.3.12|2Pe.3:12]]; ptcp., glowing, [[Rev.1.15|Rev.1:15]] Metaphorical, of grief or indignation, [[2Co.11.29|2Co.11:29]] of lust, [[1Co.7.9|1Co.7:9]]
2. Of metals (cf. [[Job.22.25|Job.22:25]], [[Psa.12.7|Psa.12:7]], [[Zec.13.9|Zec.13:9]]), **to be refined or purified by fire**: [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]] (and so in RV, [[Rev.1.15|Rev.1:15]], but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4493.def:
**ῥιπή**, ῆς, ἡ
(ῥίπτω),
poët. in cl., any rapid movement such as the throw or flight of a javelin, the rush of wind or flame, the flapping of wings, the twinkling of lights; ῥ. ὀφθαλμοῦ, the twinkling of an eye: [[1Co.15.52|1Co.15:52]] (L, mg., ῥοπή, which see).†
(AS)

G4432.def:
**πτωχεία**, -ας, ἡ
(πτωχεύω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
**beggary, destitution**: [[2Co.8.2; 8.9|2Co.8:2 8:9]], [[Rev.2.9|Rev.2:9]].†
(AS)

G4433.def:
**πτωχεύω**
(πτωχός), [in LXX: [[Jdg.6.6|Jdg.6:6]], [[Psa.79.8|Psa.79:8]] (דָּלַל); [[Jdg.14.15|Jdg.14:15]] A, [[Pro.23.21|Pro.23:21]] (יָרַשׁ); [[Psa.34.10|Psa.34:10]] (רוּשׁ), [[Tob.4.21|Tob.4:21]] * ;]
1. to be a beggar, to beg (so chiefly in cl.).
2. **to be poor as a beggar, to be destitute, poor**: opposite to πλούσιος ὤν, [[2Co.8.9|2Co.8:9]]†
(AS)

G4492.def:
**ῥιζόω**, -ῶ
(ῥίζα), [in LXX: [[Isa.40.24|Isa.40:24]], [[Jer.12.2|Jer.12:2]] (שָׁרַשׁ), [[Sir.3.28; 24.12|Sir.3:28 24:12]] * ;]
to cause to take root. Metaphorical, **to plant, fix firmly, establish**: pass. (EV, rooted), ἐν ἀγάπῃ, [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]](17); ἐν Χριστῷ, [[Col.2.7|Col.2:7]] (cf. ἐκ ριζόω).†
(AS)

G4426.def:
**πτύρομαι ** depon.,
**to be startled, frightened**: [[Php.1.28|Php.1:28]] (The active πτύρω is also found in some late writers.) †
(AS)

G4409.def:
**πρωτεύω**
(πρῶτος) [in LXX: [[Est.5.11|Est.5:11]], [[2Ma.6.18|2Ma.6:18]] [[2Mac.13.15|2Mac 13:15]] * ;]
**to be first, pre-eminent, have the first place**: [[Col.1.18|Col.1:18]]†
(AS)

G4472.def:
**ῥαντίζω **
[in LXX: [[Lev.6.27|Lev.6:27]] (20), [[2Ki.9.33|4Ki.9:33]] (נָזָה), [[Psa.51.7|Psa.51:7]] (חָטָא pi.) * ;]
= cl., ῥαίνω,
**to sprinkle, besprinkle**: with accusative, [[Heb.9.13, 19|Heb.9:13, 19]]; id. and dative, [[Heb.9.21|Heb.9:21]] pass., [[Rev.19.13|Rev.19:13]], WH; of cleansing by sprinkling, [[Heb.10.22|Heb.10:22]] (see M, _Gr._, ii, 100); mid., [[Mrk.7.4|Mrk.7:4]] (WH, txt., R, mg.).†
περι-ραίνω
(-ρραίνω, Rec., see WH, _App._, 139 f.), [in LXX for נָזָה hi. ;]
**to sprinkle around**: [[Rev.19.13|Rev.19:13]] T (ῤεραντισμένον, WH; ῤε-, R, txt.; βεβαμμένον, Rec., R, mg.).†
(AS)

G4460.def:
**Ῥαάβ**
(and Ραχάβ, [[Mat.1.5|Mat.1:5]] Ραχάβη, -ης, in FlJ), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. רָחָב)
Rahab (LXX, [[Jos.2.1|Jos.2:1]], al.): [[Heb.11.31|Heb.11:31]], [[Jas.2.25|Jas.2:25]].†
(AS)

G4415.def:
**πρωτοτόκια**, -ων, τά
(πρωτότοκος) [in LXX (with seel. -εῖα, -εία): [[Gen.25.31|Gen.25:31]] ff. [[Gen.27.36|Gen.27:36]], [[Deu.21.17|Deu.21:17]], [[1Ch.5.1|1Ch.5:1]] (בְּכוֹרָה) * ;]
**the rights of the first-born, birthright **(= cl. ἡ πρεσβεία): [[Heb.12.16|Heb.12:16]]†
(AS)

G4473.def:
**ῥαντισμός**, -ῦo, ὁ
(ῥαντίζω), [in LXX for נִדָּה ;]
**sprinkling**: of the ceremonial sprinkling of blood for purification, [[Heb.12.24|Heb.12:24]], [[1Pe.1.2|1Pe.1:2]] (see Hort, Pe., 23 ff.).†
(AS)

G4494.def:
**ῥιπίζω**
(ῥιπίς, a fan) [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:35 (נְשָׂא) * ;]
primarily, to fan a fire, hence generally, to make a breeze (Plut., al.). In pass. (cf. Philo, de inter. round., 24), **to be tossed or blown by the wind**: of waves, ἀνεμιζομένῳ καὶ ῥιπιζομένῳ, blown and raised with the wind (Hort, in l), [[Jas.1.6|Jas.1:6]]†
(AS)

G4406.def:
**πρώϊμος**, see: πρόϊμος .
**πρόϊμος** (Rec. πρώ-, of which προ- is a late form; see Bl., § 6, 4; WH, _App._, 152), -ον,
[in LXX: [[Deu.11.14|Deu.11:14]] (יוֹרֶה), etc. ;]
= the more common πρώιος (which see),
**early**: of rain (as most frequently in LXX), [[Jas.5.7|Jas.5:7]]†
(AS)

G4423.def:
**πτόησις**, -εως, ἡ
(πτοέω) [in LXX: [[Pro.3.25|Pro.3:25]] (פַּחַד), [[Sir.50.4|Sir 50:4]] א1, [[1Ma.3.25|1Ma.3:25]] R * ;]
a fluttering, excitement, caused by any emotion, but esp. by fear, **hence, terror**: φοβεῖσθαι πτόησιν, to be afraid with (cogn. accusative) or of any terror (see _ICC_, in l): [[1Pe.3.6|1Pe.3:6]]†
(AS)

G4451.def:
**πύρωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(πυρόω), [in LXX: [[Pro.27.21|Pro.27:21]] (כּוּר), [[Amo.4.9|Amo.4:9]] (שְׁדֵפָה) * ;]
1. **a burning**: [[Rev.18.9, 18|Rev.18:9, 18]].
2. **a refining or trial by fire**: metaphorically, [[1Pe.4.12|1Pe.4:12]]†
(AS)

G4407.def:
**πρωινός**
(Rec. -ϊνος, see WH, _App._, ή, -όν (πρωί), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;]
= cl. πρώιος,
**at early morn, early**: ἀστήρ, [[Rev.2.28; 22.16|Rev.2:28 22:16]].†
(AS)

G4450.def:
**πυρρός -ά**, -όν
(πῦρ) [in LXX for אֱדֹם ;]
**fiery red**: [[Rev.6.4; 12.3|Rev.6:4 12:3]].†
Πύρρος, -ου, ὁ,
**Pyrrhus**: [[Act.20.4|Act.20:4]]†
(AS)
